description_zh: 查询云安全中心资产列表的筛选条件

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The Asset Type to query. Valid values:

ecs: queries the filter conditions for all ECS servers.
cloud_product: queries the filter conditions for all other cloud services
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产类型。取值：

ecs：表示查询所有ECS服务器的筛选条件。
cloud_product：表示查询所有其他云产品的筛选条件
parameters.name: type

ConditionType.description_en:
The type of the filter condition. Valid values:

system: default filter conditions provided by the system.
user: custom filter conditions defined by the user
ConditionType.description_zh:
筛选条件的类型。取值：

system：系统默认的筛选条件
user：用户自定义的筛选条件

FilterConditions.description_en:
The filter conditions. The value is in JSON format and contains the following fields:

filterParams: the filter parameters. The value is in JSON format and contains the following fields:
    - labelKey: the key to be rendered.

    - label: the display name.
    - value: the value of the filter condition. The value is in JSON format and contains the following fields:
        -  name: the filter option.
        -  value: the value of the filter option.
LogicalExp: the logical relationship between conditions. Valid values:
    - AND: The filter conditions have an AND relationship.
    - OR: The filter conditions have an OR relationship.
When ConditionType is set to system, labelKey exists and is used only for internationalization rendering
FilterConditions.description_zh:
筛选条件。该值为JSON格式，包含以下字段：

filterParams：过滤参数，该值为JSON格式，包含以下字段：
    - labelKey：需要渲染的KEY。

    - label：展示名
    - value：筛选条件值，该值为JSON格式，包含以下字段：
        -  name：筛选项
        -  value：筛选项对应值
LogicalExp：条件连接关系，取值：
    - AND：筛选条件是与关系
    - OR：筛选条件是或关系
当ConditionType为system时 labelKey存在，且仅作为国际化渲染时使用

Name.description_en: The name of the filter condition

NameKey.description_en: The key of the filter condition name

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
